name: qwenputer
tagline: A language model with a built-in RISC‑V CPU that runs C and MicroPython code internally.
description: qwenputer is an experimental model that embeds a 32‑bit RISC‑V CPU directly into the weights of Qwen3.5‑4B. The CPU uses the model's Gated DeltaNet layers as RAM and can execute C and MicroPython code during the model's forward passes. It is not a separate tool; the model reads <tool_call> blocks, runs the code on the internal CPU, and writes the result token by token. The repository provides a stock Qwen3_5ForCausalLM loader and a driver that boots the CPU with firmware. Researchers and developers can use it to explore integrated computation in language models or to run code without external sandboxes.
best_for: researchers studying integrated CPUs in LLMs
developers testing code execution inside a model
educators demonstrating language models as computers
hobbyists experimenting with RISC‑V inside an LLM
